ns2:course.label: Anthropology of Music
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the anthropological study of music, including the role of music in the world's societies and non-Western musical systems and cultures. Same as ANTH 416. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ANTH 103 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as ANTH 416. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ANTH 103 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Voice or Instrumental Music or Music Composition or Music History or Open Studies or Music or Musicology or Jazz Performance major(s).
